inspection.type:
∀ {κ : Type} [inst : Fintype κ] [inst_1 : DecidableEq κ] {ℓ r S : ℕ} {f : QuarticQuery.PartialBool κ}
  {μ : QuarticQuery.BitInput κ → ℝ} {L G : ℕ} (tr : QuarticQuery.BitInput κ → Fin S → Bool),
  1 ≤ L →
    (∀ (x : QuarticQuery.BitInput κ), 0 ≤ μ x) →
      ∑ x, μ x = 1 →
        (∀ (x : QuarticQuery.BitInput κ), μ x ≠ 0 → QuarticQuery.promised f x) →
          (∀ (U : QuarticQuery.QueryTree κ), U.depth ≤ L → QuarticQuery.treeSuccess f μ U ≤ 2 / 3) →
            ∀ (T : QuarticQuery.QueryTree (QuarticQuery.BitLoc ℓ r S κ)),
              T.depth ≤ G →
                |(QuarticQuery.Paper.plantedAvg μ f tr fun x => QuarticQuery.ind (T.eval x = Bool.true)) -
                      QuarticQuery.Paper.dummyAvg μ fun x => QuarticQuery.ind (T.eval x = Bool.true)| ≤
                  4 * ↑G / ↑(2 ^ ℓ) ^ 2 + ↑G / (↑(2 ^ ℓ) * ↑L) + ↑G * (2 / 3) ^ r
